verdict.rationale: RudderStack Profiles resolves identities and builds a customer 360 in your own warehouse. Entities and attributes are declared in YAML, and warehouse-native SQL is generated that handles identity resolution, identity graphs and feature aggregation. Event data also lands in auto-schematized warehouse tables, so the warehouse is the documented, queryable profile store. missing for 10: a documented profile lookup API (only the warehouse store is evidenced), detailed docs on the output profile table schema covering traits, identifiers and event history, and independent or hands-on corroboration of querying profiles.
